title: The May cover
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is the frame shop's back step with the offcut box and the dog on it. The owner of the laundromat asks if he's got two jobs now. He says one job and one strip. She says which is which. He doesn't answer fast enough.

panels.composition: The cover: a shop's back step, a box of mat offcuts, a small dog asleep across the box's edge.

image.prompt: close on a photocopied booklet cover showing a shop's back step with a box of card scraps and a small dog asleep across its edge, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner. WOOD. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner holding a small booklet and questioning a young man while a dog waits, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood. A beat. Too long a beat.

image.prompt: a young man's face hesitating a moment too long, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The owner setting the digest in the rack without waiting for the answer. She has it. The dryers.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner placing a booklet in a wire rack without waiting for an answer, dryers turning, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'Which is which.' The beat is the answer.
